clue.text: Fast food place

explanation.surface: A takeaway joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A filled bread snack is quick food, and Sandwich is also a town in Kent, south-east England.

clue.text: Some schoolmistresses lay emphasis on this

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the long word schoolmistresses are wanted, a run from its middle

explanation.surface: Teachers insisting on a point in class.
explanation.definitionFit: To accent or underline a point is to give it weight in speech.

clue.text: A concept, and the small number it turned on

parts.note: NO is the short form of number

indicators.note: the word it is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An idea, and the little figure it hinged upon.
explanation.definitionFit: An idea or belief held in the mind is a conception.

clue.text: The most unfavourable can be overcome

explanation.surface: Even the gravest misfortune may be beaten.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it is the superlative of bad; as a verb it means to defeat or get the better of.

clue.text: Turn cold and green holding on

indicators.note: the pair of pieces for cold and green hold the next word between them

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
vert is the heraldic word for green
taken as written

explanation.surface: Becoming chilly and turning green with something attached.
explanation.definitionFit: To change something into another form or faith is to transform it.

clue.text: Scenes depicted in water-colours

parts.note: read cryptically, the colours of the water are the subject: paintings of the ocean, not paintings done in a watercolour medium

explanation.surface: Pictures painted with watercolour paints.
explanation.definitionFit: Paintings or views of the ocean are marine pictures.

clue.text: Organised a revel to provide a lift

indicators.note: the letters of a revel to are organised into a new order

explanation.surface: Arranging a party to cheer everyone up.
explanation.definitionFit: Lift is the British word for the American hoisting car between floors.

clue.text: Shown on TV 88 guarded

explanation.surface: Broadcast while kept under protection.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that is broadcast is shown on screen, and something shielded behind a barrier is protected.

clue.text: Withdrawing again, losing interest

parts.note: RE is a prefix meaning again
growing weary and bored

explanation.surface: Pulling back once more because of boredom.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreating or going to bed is pulling back, and a shy person also holds back.

clue.text: Run personal transport persistently

parts.note: a car is a private vehicle
e'er, poetic for ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: Driving one's own vehicle relentlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush headlong out of control is to hurtle along.

clue.text: A once-respected figure leading a double life?

indicators.note: the piece is doubled, written twice

parts.note: is, as in exists or lives, stands for being alive

explanation.surface: A formerly admired person secretly living two lives.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'life' must be taken loosely as being: to live is to be, so IS twice.
explanation.definitionFit: An Egyptian goddess, once worshipped, is a figure formerly revered.

clue.text: Resolution of porter brought before the head

indicators.note: the beer is placed in front of the headland

parts.note: porter and stout are both dark beers
a ness is a headland, a promontory

explanation.surface: The decision of a hotel porter put before the headmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm resolve is a sturdy-heartedness, courage and determination.

clue.text: About to assess the value of the box

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
to rate is to estimate worth

explanation.surface: Roughly valuing the television set.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden packing case is a kind of box.

clue.text: See pots being thrown

indicators.note: the pots are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Watch a potter at the wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice or catch sight of is to see.

clue.text: Average sum is of the utmost importance

parts.note: par is the standard or average level
an amount is a sum

explanation.surface: A typical total being supremely significant.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme or foremost means ranking above all else.

clue.text: Fancy a little drink? Then sit still

parts.note: a sup is a small mouthful of drink
to pose is to sit still, as for a portrait

explanation.surface: Would you like a quick drink? Then stay seated.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to imagine or guess it is so.

clue.text: A moving document

parts.note: not a touching piece of paper but one that lets its holder move between countries

explanation.surface: A touching piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A travel paper issued by a government permits the bearer to cross borders.

clue.text: A taxi not making a charge

indicators.note: the letters of a taxi not are used for making something new

explanation.surface: A cab driver who refuses to charge a fare.
explanation.definitionFit: Levies imposed by the state are a charge on income and goods.

clue.text: Mixed-up characters in need of sorting out!

definitions.text: Mixed-up characters in need of sorting out!

parts.words: Mixed-up characters in need of sorting out!
parts.note: not confused people needing help but jumbled letters to be rearranged into a word

explanation.surface: Confused people who need help.
explanation.definitionFit: A word puzzle whose letters are scrambled is one awaiting rearrangement.

clue.text: Raving egghead being constrained

parts.note: raving means mad
read as the head of egg, its first letter

explanation.surface: A frenzied intellectual being held back.
explanation.definitionFit: Being compelled to do something is to be forced to do it.

clue.text: Stood up for her?

explanation.surface: Did he stand up a woman on a date?
explanation.definitionFit: Got to one's feet is the past of arise, and a red bloom is the traditional flower a man gives a woman.

clue.text: British soldiers do their duty as Territorials

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
to serve is to do one's duty

explanation.surface: Army men doing their bit as part-time volunteers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Territorial Army, Britain's part-time volunteer force, is now called the Army Reserve.

clue.text: Speak about a certain point, and elaborate

indicators.note: speak goes about, around, the point

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Talk on a specific matter, and expand upon it.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaborate as an adjective means richly decorated or fancy.

clue.text: Note an engineer on a ship gets a break

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
CE is a civil engineer
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: A ship's engineer gets time off.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause in proceedings, such as a school playtime, is an interval.

clue.text: A writer on many a mediaeval instrument

parts.note: George Bernard Shaw, the Irish playwright
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: An author writing about plenty of old instruments.
explanation.definitionFit: A reed woodwind of the Middle Ages, forerunner of the oboe.

clue.text: Talk of underworld direction

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and his realm
a course is a direction taken

explanation.surface: Talk about the way to Hades.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal speech or conversation is spoken communication.

clue.text: Believe nothing should go to waste

parts.note: O, the figure zero, means nothing
to pine is to waste away

explanation.surface: Thinking nothing ought to be thrown away.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold or state a view is to think.

clue.text: Bad debts incurred by central body

indicators.note: the debts follow on from the middle piece
the central letters of body are taken

parts.note: IOUs are written promises to pay, debts

explanation.surface: Bad debts run up by a central authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Hateful or repugnant things are thoroughly bad.

clue.text: Anger-anger about nasty trait

indicators.note: ire goes about, around, the rearranged letters

parts.note: ire is anger

indicators.note: trait is turned into a nasty mess, rearranged

explanation.surface: Rage upon rage at an unpleasant characteristic.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated word is the setter's device: the first 'Anger' is the verb defined, the second the noun used in the wordplay; 'nasty' scrambles the trait and 'about' wraps the noun around it.
explanation.definitionFit: To vex or annoy someone is to make them cross.

clue.text: Thus a musician's sustained

parts.note: the clue says what a musician writes on a score to mean held for full value, an Italian direction

explanation.surface: This is how a player says long-held.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian marking meaning held for the full length of the note, a musician's word for sustained.

clue.text: Such animals can make vets reel!

indicators.note: the letters of vets reel are made into a new word

explanation.surface: Creatures so wild they leave veterinarians staggering.
explanation.definitionFit: Young hares in their first year are a kind of animal.
